description: This file contains utility functions for handling and transforming ShardedTensor objects within the PyTorch distributed checkpointing framework, specifically including a function to flatten nested ShardedTensors for checkpointing purposes.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Represents a shard of a ShardedTensor.

classes.name: ShardedTensor
classes.description: Represents a distributed tensor partitioned into multiple shards.

classes.name: ShardMetadata
classes.description: Metadata associated with a shard of a ShardedTensor.

classes.name: ShardedTensorMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for the entire ShardedTensor, including all shard metadata.

methods.name: _flatten_sharded_tensors
methods.description: Transforms a state_dict by flattening nested ShardedTensor instances into a form suitable for checkpointing.
